pages.title: Power losses and junction temperature
body: T_j ≈ T_A + P R_θJA. Lowering thermal resistance lowers the temperature rise at the same power.
MOSFET on-resistance includes source, channel and drain contributions: R_on ≈ R_S + R_CH + R_D. A high voltage and current combination can exceed a device’s safe operating area.

pages.title: Thyristors and power structures
body: In the simplified SCR model with no gate current, I_A ≈ I_leak/(1 − α_1 − α_2). Regeneration rises as the gain sum approaches 1.
A latched SCR stays on until its current falls below the holding current. A power MOSFET uses a vertical drift region to support off-state voltage.

pages.title: Microwave and quantum devices
body: 60 GHz is in the 30–300 GHz millimetre-wave band. A tunnel-diode oscillator needs operation below its resistive cutoff in the simple model.
Gunn domain stability uses the product n_0 L. An RTD can show negative differential resistance as bias shifts alignment with a resonant level. If the model specifies 2E_1/q, 0.10 eV gives 0.20 V.
RF conversion efficiency is RF output power divided by DC input power.

pages.title: Optical absorption
body: Absorption needs photons with energy at least E_g in the direct-transition model. E (eV) ≈ 1.24/λ (μm).
Transmission through thickness d is exp(−αd), ignoring reflection. A larger α means absorption closer to the surface.

pages.title: Solar cells
body: At short circuit I_sc ≈ I_L. In the ideal model, V_oc increases logarithmically with illumination.
At the maximum-power point, P_max = I_m V_m. Fill factor is P_max/(I_sc V_oc).

pages.title: Photodetectors
body: A PIN photodiode collects carriers by drift across a depleted region, with transit time roughly distance divided by drift speed.
Unit carrier collection gives J_L = qηΦ_0 for photon flux Φ_0 and collected fraction η. An APD multiplies primary current by impact ionization, at the cost of higher bias and noise.

pages.title: LEDs and semiconductor lasers
body: Direct-gap materials favor radiative recombination. A photon’s wavelength is set approximately by the transition energy.
An LED emits spontaneously, with a broader spectrum. Extraction losses reduce external efficiency. A laser needs population inversion and round-trip gain that balances loss.

pages.title: Fabrication steps and yield
body: Pattern the resist by lithography, then use selective etching or another process to transfer the pattern. Cleanrooms help prevent particles from disrupting small features.
Yield is the fraction of dies that pass. Stage yields multiply. With the same defect density, smaller dies are less likely to contain a killer defect.

pages.title: Wafer test and packaging
body: Wafer probing screens dies before dicing and packaging. Final test verifies the packaged device.
The package provides electrical connections and a heat path. The die-attach layer in the figure links the chip to its substrate.
